cosmopedia.orbitcore.earth.title: Earth
cosmopedia.orbitcore.earth.text: The third planet from the Sun and, so far, the only known home of life. The space program starts here: metals, fuel and the first rockets are all made on Earth. Gravity is 1 g, and everything that goes to space has to be pushed against it.
cosmopedia.orbitcore.moon.title: The Moon
cosmopedia.orbitcore.moon.text: Earth's only natural satellite. Gravity is six times weaker than on Earth and there is no air, so a spacesuit is required on the surface. The dark patches are lunar seas of frozen basalt; the bright areas are ancient highlands. Polar craters that never see the Sun may hide water ice. Observers sometimes report a strange glint inside one of the craters that neither sunlight nor ice can explain.
cosmopedia.orbitcore.bauxite.title: Bauxite
cosmopedia.orbitcore.bauxite.text: A rusty sedimentary rock and the main ore of aluminum. Aluminum is bound to oxygen too tightly to be smelted in a furnace, so it takes electrolysis. Light and strong, aluminum will become the backbone of rocket hulls.
cosmopedia.orbitcore.rutile.title: Rutile
cosmopedia.orbitcore.rutile.text: Dark red needle crystals of titanium dioxide, found deep underground. Titanium withstands heat and loads that break steel, which is why engines and spacesuits are made of it. It only smelts at very high temperatures.
cosmopedia.orbitcore.silicon.title: Silicon
cosmopedia.orbitcore.silicon.text: Made from sand or quartz in the Metallurgical Furnace. Without silicon there are no circuit boards, solar panels or flight computers. Every rocket needs a brain, and that brain is made of silicon.

cosmopedia.orbitcore.regolith.title: Regolith
cosmopedia.orbitcore.regolith.text: Lunar dust ground up by billions of years of meteorite impacts. Sharp as broken glass and clingy with static. There is no wind on the Moon, so footprints in regolith last forever. It hides helium-3, the fuel of future fusion reactors.
cosmopedia.orbitcore.ilmenite.title: Ilmenite
cosmopedia.orbitcore.ilmenite.text: A black, shiny mineral from the lunar seas: iron, titanium and oxygen. It can give a lunar base its metal and, one day, its breathing oxygen.
cosmopedia.orbitcore.lunar_ice.title: Lunar Ice
cosmopedia.orbitcore.lunar_ice.text: The Sun never rises in the craters near the poles, and water ice has gathered there for billions of years. Water is drink, oxygen and hydrogen fuel. Whoever holds the ice holds the Moon.

cosmopedia.orbitcore.zarya.title: Zarya Expedition
cosmopedia.orbitcore.zarya.text: The first expedition to the Moon, the one the newspapers never mentioned. Two cosmonauts: commander Irina Volkova and engineer Andrei Sedov. The lander is intact, its door open, the commander's records left on holographic tablets; the rover was abandoned halfway to the crater with a dead battery. The crew's footprints end in the middle of the plain.
cosmopedia.orbitcore.echo_crystal.title: Glowing Crystals
cosmopedia.orbitcore.echo_crystal.text: The crystals grow in clusters around the Echo object and glow without any source of energy. Under a microscope they show a perfect lattice that nature never makes. Hold a shard to your ear and you can hear it ring in time with the signal.
cosmopedia.orbitcore.echo.title: The Echo
cosmopedia.orbitcore.echo.text: A black faceted monolith at the center of a crater. Its material is unknown and yields to neither tools nor explosives. The object answers radio signals: it repeats them, but each time adds something of its own. The Builders left it here, and it seems they expected us to come.

cosmopedia.orbitcore.builders.title: The Builders
holo.orbitcore.zarya_1.title: Zarya, record 1
holo.orbitcore.zarya_1.author: Commander I. Volkova
holo.orbitcore.zarya_1.text:
Day three. Nominal landing. Sedov jokes that the Moon smells of gunpowder. The regolith creaks underfoot like snow.

Day five. In orbit we caught a faint signal: five tones, always the same. Houston says it's interference. It is not interference.
holo.orbitcore.zarya_2.title: Zarya, record 2
holo.orbitcore.zarya_2.author: Commander I. Volkova
holo.orbitcore.zarya_2.text:
Day six. The signal repeated our call signs. In our own voices. The tape is in the onboard recorder.

Day seven. We are driving to the source. The bearing leads to a large crater. If we don't come back, don't follow us. Don't touch anything there.
holo.orbitcore.zarya_3.title: Zarya, record 3
holo.orbitcore.zarya_3.author: Commander I. Volkova
holo.orbitcore.zarya_3.text:
The battery is dead. We go on foot. Andrei said someone was following us along our own tracks. Now Andrei is gone. His footprints end right next to mine.

He still talks to me on the radio. He says he is standing behind me.

I don't look back.
holo.orbitcore.zarya_4.title: Zarya, record 4
holo.orbitcore.zarya_4.author: Engineer A. Sedov
holo.orbitcore.zarya_4.text:
If anyone finds this. Irina walked to the monolith. She stands there in silence, and her voice is on the radio. But her mouth is closed.

It is not repeating us. It is learning to speak with us.
holo.orbitcore.builder_1.title: Fragment ▒1
holo.orbitcore.builder_1.author: The Builders
holo.orbitcore.builder_1.text: …YOU HEARD. SO YOU ARE READY TO LISTEN. The stones you found are not monuments. They are beacons. Each one leads to the next.
holo.orbitcore.builder_2.title: Fragment ▒2
holo.orbitcore.builder_2.author: The Builders
holo.orbitcore.builder_2.text: We walked this road before you. We left it open. We left it for those who ▒▒▒ are not afraid of silence.
holo.orbitcore.builder_3.title: Fragment ▒3
holo.orbitcore.builder_3.author: The Builders
holo.orbitcore.builder_3.text: Time is not a river. It is a depth. The closer to what holds the light, the slower your hour flows, and the faster everyone else's.
holo.orbitcore.builder_4.title: Fragment ▒4
holo.orbitcore.builder_4.author: The Builders
holo.orbitcore.builder_4.text: Where light cannot leave, there is a world on the edge. We wait there. ▒▒▒ orbit ▒▒▒ horizon ▒▒▒ waiting.
holo.orbitcore.builder_5.title: Fragment ▒5
holo.orbitcore.builder_5.author: The Builders
holo.orbitcore.builder_5.text: Everyone who comes brings a voice. The Echo keeps voices. Nothing is lost. No one is lost completely.
holo.orbitcore.builder_6.title: Fragment ▒6
holo.orbitcore.builder_6.author: The Builders
holo.orbitcore.builder_6.text: Do not fear those who stand behind you. They are what remains of you if you stop.
holo.orbitcore.builder_7.title: Fragment ▒7
holo.orbitcore.builder_7.author: The Builders
holo.orbitcore.builder_7.text: Your world will change while you are gone. Its rivers will turn, its stones will become different. Come back, even if there is nothing to come back to.
holo.orbitcore.builder_8.title: Fragment ▒8
holo.orbitcore.builder_8.author: The Builders
holo.orbitcore.builder_8.text: The next beacon is red. Cold. Under a cap of ice. ▒▒▒ listen.
